title: Screening manifest holds duplicate unit ids with different fix PRs
body:
evals/units/screening-manifest.json holds several ids twice with different fixPr/base/fix (seen 2026-11-17: t-ehzy3ue, t-eg7cms5, t-1xwyjlv); unitId hashes the issue URL, so two fix PRs of one issue share an id and verify --id grades whichever row find() hits first.
Outcome: verify refuses a manifest with a duplicate id (exit non-zero naming the ids), and the committed manifest has none (one row per id kept, the choice recorded).
Proof: a test with a duplicate-id manifest asserts the refusal; verify --recorded on the committed manifest still prints >= 70.
